high_level_description: This image is a sponsored post from the Instagram account "paperboard.mag," promoting a dessert at a location called "GIGI" in Bandra, Mumbai. The post features a close-up of a bowl of tiramisu, a classic Italian dessert consisting of layers of ladyfinger cookies soaked in coffee and mascarpone cheese, and then dusted with cocoa powder.
